info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Loan Details API
info.description: The Update Loan Details API allows financial institutions to modify existing loan information based on the provided loan ID. This endpoint facilitates the adjustment of key loan attributes, ensuring that customer records are always up to date. Typical consumers of this API are loan management systems and customer relationship management platforms looking to streamline their operations. By providing an intuitive interface for loan updates, organizations can enhance customer service and improve operational efficiency.

put.description: This endpoint allows the user to update the details of a specified loan by its ID. It accepts various fields that may need to be modified and ensures the changes are persisted in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the loan identified by LOAN-500045. It should contain the necessary fields to perform the update operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
